author: The Desk
title: Week 11: Decided By A Tenth Of A Point
body:
Kenzos 119.26, Los Pollos Hermanos 119.16. A tenth of a point is now the smallest margin in league history, past the 0.42 by which My Carr is a lemon beat Thunder Gun Express in Week 10 of 2022. In 335 regular-season games across five seasons, nothing had been closer than four tenths. Kenzos has beaten Los Pollos Hermanos twice this year by a combined 8.76 points.

Shadynasty had the week's best number, 179.90, and spent it on Thunder Gun Express, which managed 111.60. That 68.30 margin led the week but ranks 31st all time, so it stays off the blowout card. Brendawg21's 65.46 in a 118.06 loss to druppert does not stay off: it is the fifth-lowest single-week score the league has recorded, and two of the five lowest now belong to Brendawg21 this season.

Nobody moved in or out of the top six. Kenzos took first place from The Uncletaker on points for — both are 9-2, separated by 8.92 — with Los Muertos third at the same record and IR Specialist fourth at 8-3. Shadynasty is fifth at 7-4 and has allowed 1,257.54 points, the fewest in the league. Los Pollos Hermanos holds the last spot at 4-7, a game ahead of Thunder Gun Express and Jimmy Marino.

Thunder Gun Express is seventh at 3-8, beaten by 70.56 and 68.30 in consecutive weeks by the teams now seeded first and fifth. Its 1,478.40 points against are second-most in the league, behind only Brendawg21. Three weeks remain.

author: The Desk
title: Shadynasty 214.32, and Nothing Else Moves
body:
Shadynasty put 214.32 on Brendawg21 in Week 10 and won by 129.02. Both numbers go into the book. The score is the second-highest single week in league history, behind only Taylor Park Boyz's 226.02 in Week 12 of 2022, and it is a franchise best, clearing Shadynasty's own 207.94 from Week 2 of 2023. The margin is the largest in the league's five seasons, passing the 112.28 Shadynasty hung on the same opponent back in Week 1.

The Uncletaker handled Jimmy Marino 151.96 to 66.42. Marino's 66.42 was the low score of the week, and the 85.54 margin ranks tenth all-time, which leaves it off the seven-row record card. The closest game was Los Muertos over druppert, 155.70 to 149.52, a 6.18 margin that ranks 35th and does not come near the card either. Los Pollos Hermanos beat IR Specialist by 9.68.

Nothing moved. The top six after Week 10 are the same six teams in the same order as after Week 9: The Uncletaker at 9-1, Kenzos at 8-2, Los Muertos at 8-2, IR Specialist at 7-3, Shadynasty at 6-4, and Los Pollos Hermanos at 4-6. The Uncletaker's 9-1 start ties Shadynasty's 2023 team for the best ten-week start the league has seen. Los Pollos Hermanos hold the last playoff seat on a losing record, one game clear of Thunder Gun Express and Jimmy Marino.

Thunder Gun Express lost to Kenzos 157.56 to 87.00, its lowest output of the season, and sits seventh at 3-7. At the bottom, Brendawg21's 882.58 points through ten weeks is the lowest ten-week total any team has posted in the league's five seasons.

author: The Desk
title: Kenzos Post 190.96; the Sixth Seed Changes Hands
body:
Kenzos put up 190.96 against Brendawg21's 114.28, the high score of Week 9 and the eighth-highest regular-season score in league history. It does not crack the seven rows the record card shows, but it is the second week running that Kenzos landed in the all-time top ten, after 187.48 in Week 8. At 7-2 with 1,386.70 points for, Kenzos has scored more through nine games than any team in any of the league's five seasons, passing the 1,379.12 Shadynasty had at this point in 2023.

The widest margin belonged to The Uncletaker, 166.34 to IR Specialist's 84.58, a gap of 81.76 points and the eleventh-largest the league has recorded. The Uncletaker stays first at 8-1. IR Specialist's 84.58 was the week's lowest total and, while the record holds at 7-2, the loss dropped them from second to fourth on points for behind Kenzos and Los Muertos, who won 137.72 to 116.78 at Shadynasty.

The closest game was Jimmy Marino over druppert, 100.74 to 97.48 - a 3.26-point margin, fourteenth-narrowest all-time and also short of the seven rows on the card. Nothing from Week 9 entered a record-book list the site displays.

The sixth seed changed hands on the head-to-head. Los Pollos Hermanos beat Thunder Gun Express 114.76 to 101.32, and the two swapped places. Both sit at 3-6; Los Pollos Hermanos holds the final playoff spot on points for, 1,104.10 to 1,079.22, a margin of 24.88 with five weeks to play. Thunder Gun Express has now lost six of nine and scores less than every team above it.

author: The Desk
title: Kenzos hang 187 on Los Muertos; Uncletaker takes the top seed
body:
Kenzos put up 187.48 against Los Muertos on Sunday and won by 108.68, the largest margin of Week 8 and the third-largest in the league's five seasons. The top three now all belong to 2026: Shadynasty beat Brendawg21 by 112.28 in Week 1, Los Muertos beat The Uncletaker by 111.80 in Week 2, and this. Kenzos' 187.48 is the ninth-highest single-game score on record, which leaves it one spot off the seven rows the all-time card shows, and third-best this season behind Los Muertos' 195.80 and The Uncletaker's 195.50.

Los Muertos' 78.80 was the price. They came into the week 6-1 and holding the top seed on points; they leave it 6-2 and fourth. The Uncletaker took over first at 7-1 by beating Los Pollos Hermanos 155.68-138.36, with IR Specialist also 7-1 and second on the 132.62-point gap in points for. Kenzos sit third at 6-2, Shadynasty fifth at 5-3 after handling Jimmy Marino 138.80-115.38.

The closest game was IR Specialist over druppert, 127.20-113.08, a 14.12-point win; The Uncletaker's 17.32 over Los Pollos Hermanos was the only other result inside twenty. No team entered or left the top six, and the four clubs below it stayed put. Brendawg21's 70.92 was the week's low score and leaves them 1-7 and last in the league in both wins and points for.

Thunder Gun Express beat Brendawg21 125.78-70.92 for their third win and hold the sixth and final playoff seed at 3-5, one game ahead of Los Pollos Hermanos. Their 977.90 points for ranks seventh of ten, and they have been outscored by 48.28 on the season.

author: The Desk
title: Top Seed Changes Hands, Top Six Does Not
body:
The Uncletaker posted the week's high score, 168.78, in a 29.26-point win over druppert. The widest margin belonged to Los Pollos Hermanos, who beat Brendawg21 126.84-82.46; at 44.38 points it ranks 83rd on the all-time margin list and does not trouble the record book. The closest game was Los Muertos' 151.40-130.38 win over Thunder Gun Express, a gap of 21.02 — the first week this season in which no game finished inside twenty points.

IR Specialist arrived at 6-0 and left at 6-1, losing 144.32-116.12 to Shadynasty. That puts three teams at 6-1, so the order is settled on points for: Los Muertos first at 1054.88, The Uncletaker second at 1043.72, IR Specialist third at 939.58. IR Specialist had led the table for the previous two weeks.

Nobody moved in or out of the playoff places. Kenzos (5-2) and Shadynasty (4-3) keep fourth and fifth, and Thunder Gun Express holds the sixth and final spot at 2-5 on a points-for edge of 1.24 over Los Pollos Hermanos, who traded seventh and eighth with Jimmy Marino. druppert and Brendawg21 are both 1-6.

No all-time list changed hands this week. The one figure worth watching: Los Muertos' 1054.88 points through seven games is the third-best seven-game start in league history, behind Shadynasty's 1064.10 in 2023 and Kenzos' 1056.04 in 2024. Thunder Gun Express scored 130.38, its third-highest total of the season, and lost anyway; it has now cleared 100 points in six of seven weeks and sits 2-5.

author: The Desk
title: Nobody Clears 130
body:
IR Specialist beat Kenzos 128.76-114.50, and that 128.76 was the best score anyone managed in Week 6. It is the lowest week-winning number in the five seasons of this league — the previous floor was the 134.16 that took Week 14 of 2022. The ten teams combined for 1,118.46 points, the second-lightest week on record, behind only that same 2022 Week 14 at 1,076.20.

The win leaves IR Specialist 6-0, the second undefeated start through six games in league history after Kenzos did it in 2024. Los Muertos beat Brendawg21 126.68-106.14 and sits a game back at 5-1 while leading the league in scoring at 903.48. The Uncletaker took the week's closest game, 118.38-110.32 over Shadynasty, and holds the three seed at 5-1.

The widest margin was druppert's 120.18-82.20 win over Los Pollos Hermanos, 37.98 points. The losing 82.20 was also the week's low score, though it goes nowhere near the record card: it ranks 14th-lowest across all five seasons, and the all-time list only shows seven. Nothing else from Week 6 landed in a top-ten list either.

Thunder Gun Express beat Jimmy Marino 114.08-97.22 and took the sixth and last playoff seed in the process. The two are both 2-4, and the tiebreak is points for, where Thunder Gun Express leads 721.84 to 693.16. Jimmy Marino falls to seventh.

author: The Desk
title: Uncletaker Hits 195.50; Jimmy Marino Takes the Sixth Seed
body:
The Uncletaker put up 195.50 against Kenzos, the highest score of Week 5 and the sixth-highest single game in league history. Kenzos answered with 159.74, a number that would have won three of the week's other four games, and lost by 35.76 anyway. Kenzos holds the third seed on points at 4-1; The Uncletaker is fourth at the same record.

Jimmy Marino took the week's widest margin, 164.50 to 93.56 over Brendawg21. The 70.94-point win ranks 17th all-time and does not reach the record board. It was enough to move Jimmy Marino into the sixth and final playoff seed at 2-3, pushing Rum Hammers out after a 136.32-106.20 loss to Los Muertos. Shadynasty handled druppert 135.24-104.30.

IR Specialist is 5-0, only the second team to open a season that way; Kenzos did it in 2024. It has done so on 694.70 points, the smallest total of anyone in the top five. Los Muertos leads the league at 776.80 and sits second. At the other end, druppert is 0-5, the first winless-through-five start in the league's five seasons.

Thunder Gun Express lost the week's narrowest game, 125.16-107.60 to IR Specialist, a fourth straight defeat that leaves it 1-4 and eighth. Its 607.76 points rank seventh; Jimmy Marino holds the last playoff spot with fewer.

author: The Desk
title: Week 4: Decided by 0.56
body:
The Uncletaker posted the week's high score, 187.12, in a 56.66-point win over Thunder Gun Express. It is the ninth-highest single-game total in the league's five seasons, which leaves it off the record board, and the second-best mark of 2026 behind the 195.80 Los Muertos hung on The Uncletaker back in Week 2.

Los Muertos handled the blowout instead. They beat Jimmy Marino 150.48 to 64.64, a margin of 85.84 that ranks seventh all time and does make the board. Jimmy Marino's 64.64 was the fourth-lowest score any team has put up since 2022.

The closest game was not close to close: IR Specialist 101.52, Brendawg21 100.96. The 0.56-point margin is the second-narrowest in league history, behind only the 0.42 that separated My Carr is a lemon and Thunder Gun Express in Week 10 of 2022. The win kept IR Specialist unbeaten, though Kenzos are also 4-0 and hold the top seed on points for, 603.14 to 569.54.

The back end of the top six turned over. Rum Hammers beat Shadynasty 167.82 to 154.10 and climbed from ninth to sixth; Thunder Gun Express fell out to seventh. Thunder Gun Express is 1-3 and has now allowed 581.48 points, the most in the league, having drawn the week's highest score as its Week 4 opponent. druppert remains the only winless team at 0-4.

author: The Desk
title: Week 3: The Last Playoff Spot Changes Hands Again
body:
Kenzos posted the week's best score, 152.24, and needed most of it: Shadynasty came back with 142.14 and lost by 10.10. Kenzos and IR Specialist, who beat Los Muertos 148.84-127.24, are the only teams left at 3-0. It is the first season in league history with two of them.

The Uncletaker beat Brendawg21 148.18-84.64, a 63.54-point margin that would have carried most weeks and still does not touch the all-time top ten, where the bar is 79.84. At the other end, Jimmy Marino beat Rum Hammers 121.70-118.76. That 2.94-point margin is the tenth-closest game in five years of this league, and the only new entry the record book picked up this week.

IR Specialist and Kenzos now hold the top two seeds. Los Muertos, which still leads the league in points for at 490.00, drops to third after its first loss, and Shadynasty to fourth. The sixth and last playoff spot moved again: Brendawg21 fell from sixth to eighth, and Thunder Gun Express climbed from ninth into it. Rum Hammers are 0-3 for the first time in franchise history; druppert are 0-3 for the third year running.

Thunder Gun Express got its first win, 129.92-85.04 over druppert, and sits sixth at 1-2 with 369.70 points for. Week 4 is The Uncletaker, 2-1.

author: The Desk
title: Week 2: The Blowout Record Survives By 0.48
body:
Los Muertos put 195.80 on the board, the best score anyone has managed since 2023 and the fifth-highest in league history. The Uncletaker answered with 84.00. The 111.80-point margin is the second-largest ever recorded here, and it misses the record Shadynasty set seven days ago by 0.48. Two weeks into the season, the two biggest beatings in five years of this league are both from this month.

Brendawg21 over druppert, 90.90-85.82, was the closest game and the lowest-scoring one. The only other single-digit margin was Kenzos over Rum Hammers, 130.08-121.42. IR Specialist beat Jimmy Marino 165.48-111.64 and Shadynasty beat Thunder Gun Express 151.86-94.26, neither of which was in doubt for long.

Four teams are 2-0 and hold the top four seeds in points order: Los Muertos, IR Specialist, Shadynasty, Kenzos. The sixth and final playoff spot now belongs to Brendawg21, which climbed from tenth to sixth on a five-point win while sitting dead last in points for at 144.32 — a hundred points behind three of the teams beneath it. Rum Hammers, 37-19 all time and the winningest franchise never to win anything, are 0-2.

Thunder Gun Express is ninth at 0-2, with 239.78 points for, which is ninety-five more than the team currently holding the last playoff spot. Week 3 is druppert, the league's other 0-2 team and the only one scoring less.

author: The Desk
title: Week 1: The Record Book Takes Two Hits In One Game
body:
Los Muertos put up the week's best number, 166.96, and spent it on druppert, who managed 110.46. Shadynasty finished second at 165.70. That game is the one that will get talked about.

Shadynasty 165.70, Brendawg21 53.42. The 112.28-point margin is the largest in league history, past IR Specialist's 108.62 over Jimmy Marino in Week 5 of 2023. Brendawg21's 53.42 is now the lowest single-week score ever recorded here, taking the mark off Thunder Gun Express, whose 60.30 in Week 13 of last season had held it for nine months. Two all-time records, one matchup, opening week.

The only game inside ten points was The Uncletaker over Jimmy Marino, 141.76-133.46. The five winners hold the first five seeds on points; the sixth and final playoff spot goes to the best of the 0-1 teams, which is where the points-for tiebreaker starts earning its keep.

That sixth seed is Thunder Gun Express at 145.52, a number that beat five of the other nine teams and not the one it was actually matched against. Jimmy Marino and Rum Hammers are next in line at 133.46 and 127.74, twelve and eighteen points of scoring back of it. Brendawg21 is tenth and would like Week 2 to arrive promptly.

author: The Desk
title: Four Champions, Four Different Doors
body:
Five seasons in, this league has handed out four trophies to four different teams, and only one of them was the team everybody saw coming.

druppert took the first one in 2022 out of the four seed at 8-6. Kenzos won it in 2023 at 7-7 — the six seed, the last team in, the worst record ever to lift it here. Los Muertos did it from fourth in 2024. Not until last year did the best regular-season team actually finish the job, when Shadynasty went 11-3 and closed it out.

The cruelty is on the other side of that ledger. Shadynasty's 2023 team went 12-2 and scored 2,186.58 points, still the league record by 163, and won nothing; the following year it went 4-10. Rum Hammers are 37-19 all time, second-most wins in the league, four playoff trips, zero rings. Brendawg21 have played four seasons and have yet to see a bracket. Thunder Gun Express sit at exactly 28-28, which is either balance or purgatory.

So: ten teams, fourteen weeks, six spots, and four years of evidence that the table means less here than it should. Week 1 kicks off with everybody at 0-0 and the record book wide open.
